component.name: Zombo's Razor
component.summary: Diagnose DNS, email authentication, TLS and domain registration

description.p: Zombo's Razor is a native desktop app for support engineers. Enter a domain and it runs the Checks that explain why mail or a site does not work, then lists the Findings in plain words.
It contacts only the Targets you enter and a short list of documented services. It has no telemetry and no accounts.
